appearance_facts.location: Upper-left quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: The dark red wedge (Fossil Fuels) is the largest visible sector, spanning from the 12 o'clock position to approximately the 10 o'clock position.

appearance_facts.location: Right side of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: The light orange wedge (Nuclear) is the second largest visible sector, extending from the 12 o'clock position to approximately the 4 o'clock position.

appearance_facts.location: Left side of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: The medium orange wedge (Renewables) is the third largest visible sector, extending from approximately the 10 o'clock position to the 7 o'clock position.
The pale yellow wedge (Hydroelectric) is the smallest visible sector, extending from approximately the 7 o'clock position to the 4 o'clock position.
